bns:Component.name: Util_Seed_InterfaceRegistry
bns:Component.bns:description: One-off utility process (run manually via test-execute, not deployed for scheduled/listener use) that inserts the 5 Cost Object interfaces (CO_GLA/CO_ACT/CO_WBS/CO_WBSACT/CO_WO) into interface_registry, so TEMPLATE_Standard_P2P_Parent's transaction_log FK is satisfied for each - closing the gap where those 5 processes previously bypassed interface_registry and the shared framework subprocesses entirely. domain_name=COST_OBJECT for all 5, source_system=EAM, target_system=Ivalua. Safe to re-run only after manually clearing existing rows first - interface_registry.interface_id is a primary key, so a second run without cleanup fails on duplicate key. | built with boomi-companion v1.0.57
